quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on his debut and first impact for the Bucks
quotes.excerpt: It was a dream come true, something I've been waiting for ever since I picked up the basketball.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Jersey goes on, it's preseason, what did that kind of feel like when coach called your number to check in?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: It was a dream come true, something I've been waiting for ever since I picked up the basketball. I'm just very grateful to be able to finally make a debut even if it wasn't a real game.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament on his preseason debut with the Bucks: It was a dream come true, something I have been waiting for ever since I picked up the basketball.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Nate Ament on his mindset coming off the bench
quotes.excerpt: I always try to stay ready when your number is called.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Catch and shoot three, offensive rebound putback, tied the game and gave you guys a lead. What did that feel like getting in the flow and immediately making an impact?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: It felt good. I always try to stay ready when your number is called. That was kind of my mindset on the bench, my time is coming, my time is going to come, so I think that helped me get into the moment.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament on his mindset coming off the bench: I always try to stay ready when your number is called. That was kind of my mindset on the bench, my time is coming.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Coaching staff focus on Ament's defensive length and effort
quotes.excerpt: He's been harping, you know, with my length and size, I can be very effective on defense.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What are the main things the coaches have been working on you with in terms of improving your game?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: Some of the effort plays, just running the floor, grabbing extra offensive rebounds. Especially on the defensive side of the ball, he's been harping, you know, with my length and size, I can be very effective on defense, so that's been one of his main things for me.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament says the coaching staff is emphasizing his defensive potential: He has been harping, you know, with my length and size, I can be very effective on defense.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Ament on the team's commitment to the coach's defensive intensity
quotes.excerpt: It's easy to get behind a coach who really just preaches competing.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Taylor was telling us the defensive intensity needs to be better. For a guy like that, it feels like you guys all trust him, listen to him. When you hear that as a collective group, what are you thinking about?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: We all knew it. Coming after the game, we all knew we have to take it up a couple notches. Some of it is tactically, we have to figure stuff out, but also just competing each and every day. It's easy to get behind a coach who really just preaches competing and trying to outcompete the other team.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament on the team defensive intensity: We all knew we have to take it up a couple notches. It is easy to get behind a coach who really just preaches competing and trying to outcompete the other team.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Ament on veteran teammates guiding him through his rookie year
quotes.excerpt: Even people like Jaime Jaquez Jr. who is in his second year, he's been doing a great job.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Have any of your older teammates been particularly helpful in guiding you along and letting you know what to expect?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: Really everybody. Even people like Jaime Jaquez Jr. who is in his second year, he's been doing a great job of just walking me through what a rookie year would look like. Jaime, Taurean Prince, Gary Trent Jr. especially has been doing a great job. He was talking to me throughout the game, just keep saying be aggressive, keep playing your game. When you have a group like that that's trying to build you up, it's easier to perform.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament credits Gary Trent Jr., Taurean Prince, and Jaime Jaquez Jr. for helping him navigate his rookie season: When you have a group like that that is trying to build you up, it is easier to perform.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Ament on the value of unique practice drills
quotes.excerpt: He's just trying to put us in a chaotic position.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: There's been some unique drills. How have you taken that? What has that been like to go through some of those advantage, disadvantage situations?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: He's just trying to put us in a chaotic position, and that's kind of what the game calls for a lot of the times. On defense you're trying to take away their advantage, on offense you're trying to create advantages, so to kind of put us in those mini games and have us think around the game is kind of going to help us throughout the year.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament on the unique practice drills used by the coaching staff: He is just trying to put us in a chaotic position, and that is kind of what the game calls for a lot of the times.

quotes.speaker: Nate Ament
quotes.summary_phrase: Ament's personal goals for improvement after his debut
quotes.excerpt: Defensively for sure, these guys in the NBA are the best of the best.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: What do you feel like you personally want to improve on from tonight's game?

text_blocks.speaker: Nate Ament
text_blocks.text: Defensively for sure, these guys in the NBA are the best of the best, so you got to be very focused. I think just defensively I can make a better impact, crashing the offensive glass, and then just overall cohesion with the team, just bringing that when I step into the court.

quotes.social_post: Nate Ament on his areas for improvement after his debut: Defensively for sure, these guys in the NBA are the best of the best, so you got to be very focused.
